locations.title: King & Queen Puzzle
locations.description:
**Solution:**
- Grab the [Queen Plug](#loc=544164) and slot it into [Plug Socket 9](#loc=544167)
- Go upstairs, grab the [King Plug](#loc=544170), then drop down.
  - A zombie will be lurking - watch out!
- Use the King Plug to unlock [Plug Socket 10](#loc=544168) and unlock the [One-Way Door](#loc=544162).
  - Grab the Flamethrower if you have the space!
- Reclaim both plugs; use them to power up [Plug Socket 8](#loc=544163) and [Plug Socket 7](#loc=544166).
- Go through Socket 7's door to reach the Queen plug. Take it, go back through the previous door, then take the King plug. Done!

locations.title: Clock Tower Puzzle
locations.description:
**Solution:**
- Put the [Large Gear](#loc=543873) in the [Gear Box](#loc=543946).
- Take the [Small Gear](#loc=543950) from the gear box upstairs, and put it in this [Gear Box](#loc=543948)
- Put the Large Gear in the [Gear Box](#loc=543952) upstairs, and the [Power Panel Part](#loc=543953) will be yours!
